title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I have had regular arguments with the Bidati firqa for addressing Nabi-e-Kareem Sallallahu Alaihiwasallam by saying "YA NABI" or "YA RASOOL". When I tell them that Rasool-e-Akram Sallallahu Alaihiwasallam is in Madina and not everywhere they say I am wrong. Please provide with Hawala of authentic books and ahadith from where I can convince them on the usage of "YA" for ALLAH SWT only. 8929 views Q. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 44130 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Which madhab/sect to follow Question: Our family is Deobandi but I have question regarding sects. The Prophet (PBUH) did not leave any sects behind and forbade us from making them. So why do we have to follow one of the 4 schools of thoughts, why not the Quran and Hadith themselves. I am not saying that we totally neglect the 4 Imams or that any individual produces his own ruling. Why are people like Zakir Naik, Mohammad Salah (Huda TV) or the others you term as Salafis, wrong? They give their proves from the Quran and Sahih Hadith. Is that wrong? Of course it isn't. So should we follow the scholars of the 4 imams or trust scholars who know the Quran and Sahih Hadith well? Answer ID: 44130 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 415/1219/N=10/1434) (1) The jurisprudential rulings of four Imams are not sects rather they are the differences emerged as a result of Shariah proofs which are not nefarious in the eyes of Shariah rather they are source of mercy for the Ummah as per the Hadith. The person who does not have the ability of Ijtihad it becomes necessary for him to follow any imam out of the four as he cannot practice Shariah without Taqleed. It is necessary to follow Shariah for salvation in hereafter. And it is must to follow one of the four imam in all the rulings. It is in no way lawful to follow Imam Abu Hanifa (رحمةالله) in some rulings while Imam Malik, Imam Shafai or Imam Ahmad (رحمهم الله) in some rulings as it is talfiq (contrivance) which is haram as per the majority of Ummah. It should be noted that four Imams do not differ in all the rulings. They differ only in the rulings regarding which the Quran and Hadith are apparently clashing or they have more than one meaning or there is no explicit ayat or hadith regarding them. (2) There is a detailed fatwa about Dr. Zakir Naik on the website of Darul Uloom Deoband, you should see it, you will know the reality of Dr. Zakir Naik. Who is Muhamamd Salah of Huda TV? I do not know him. If you mean by him Al Huda International (New Name: Al-Noor International) headed by Dr. Farhat Hashmi then all the Ahl Haq Ulama of Pakistan agree that she is deviant. (For details read the book “Maghribi Jiddat Pasandi Aur Al-Huda International, Maqasid, Azaim Andeshe” you may download it from www.ahlehaq.com website). As far as the Salafi i.e. Ghair Muqallidin are concerned, they are deviant and out of Ahl Sunnah Al-Jamah because they refuse the argumentation of Qiyas and Ijma of Ummah. The commentary of the holy Quran and Hadith which they present against the Sahaba, Tabiyeen and other Akabirin Ummah is not acceptable as per the Ahl Sunnah Al Jamah. Hence it is not lawful to trust Ghair Muqallid Ulama as per Ahl Haq Ulama. They are misguided and misguide those who follow them. (3) It is not lawful as per the Ulama of Ahl Haq to trust Ghair Muqallid Ulama leaving four Imams as it is mentioned above. It is server deviation to consider that they know the holy Quran and Hadith better than four Imams. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
